description: This PHP source file defines the ResetPasswordService class, which manages the password reset process for users in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for generating reset codes, sending password reset emails, validating reset requests, and saving new passwords, utilizing various traits and external dependencies.

classes.name: ResetPasswordService
classes.description: Service class handling password reset logic, including token generation, email notifications, validation, and password updates within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Retrieves or instantiates the EmailService used for sending emails.

methods.name: getResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Retrieves or instantiates the DAO responsible for reset password requests.

methods.name: hasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Checks if a password reset request is still valid based on its timestamp.

methods.name: extractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Decodes and extracts metadata from a reset code.

methods.name: generateEmailBody
methods.description: Generate email content from template file, replacing placeholders.

methods.name: searchForUserRecord
methods.description: Finds a user by username, ensuring the account is active and associated with a valid employee.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetEmailBody
methods.description: Create email body content for password reset email with personalized data.

methods.name: sendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Sends the password reset email to the user, validating the email address.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Creates a secure reset code encoding user identifier and random bytes.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Validates if the user account is active and not terminated.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates a reset code URL, checking its existence, expiry, and current validity.

methods.name: logPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Creates a reset request record, generates reset code, and emails the user.

methods.name: saveResetPassword
methods.description: Updates user password based on credentials and records the reset, within a transaction.
